messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx / timeouts detected for inference-service in us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z. Symptoms: repeated segfaults and OOM kills on model-runner pods. Auto-threshold triggered. Pager sent to @ryan (oncall).

ryan (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Pulling graphs and recent deploys.

ryan (oncall): quick summary from grafana: 5xx rate up from ~0.1% to 12% across model-runner-prod-usw2, latency p95 jumped to 2.6s. Error logs show SIGSEGV and libc++ double free traces.

elaine (eng-runtime): seeing the same. `dmesg` on node shows OOM killer invoked around 09:10. model-runner logs include: 
```
# log excerpt
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
free(): double free detected in tcache 2
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

elaine (eng-runtime): this started right after the quant-kernel v3.7 rollout at ~09:00. Suspect kernel optim + kv-cache interaction.

marta (ops-sre): node metrics show memory pressure on g4dn-type nodes; kubelet evicting pods with highest RSS. Several pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

sam (support): impact report from support: multiple enterprise customers seeing 5xx on generation endpoints; webhooks to BoltPay and AcmeCorp failing, there are retry storms. We're getting escalations.

maya (product): any ETA for mitigation? Customers asking for status.

ryan (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic from affected nodes/pools, 2) rollback quant-kernel change if root cause confirmed, 3) route traffic to fallback model variant (smaller model) to reduce memory pressure, 4) scale up capacity if needed. Doing step 1 now.

eng-runtime-bot: action: marking runbook 'model-runner-segfault-oom' active — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-crash

elaine (eng-runtime): agree with rollback. I'm prepping a rollback to `model-runner:v2.13` (pre-kernel-change image). If ops can cordon/drain affected nodes I'll start a controlled rollback of the deployment.

marta (ops-sre): cordoning affected nodes (usw2-nodeset-3). Running `kubectl cordon` and `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`.

marta (ops-sre): drain in progress. I'll mark pods for immediate move to other nodes once we finish.

ryan (oncall): initiating traffic diversion via routing policy: `route-rule set inference-service --exclude nodeset=usw2-nodeset-3 --weight 0.0` (runbook step).

sam (support): notifying Tier 1 that we're mitigating; sending an interim status to affected customers: short note that we're aware and mitigating.

elaine (eng-runtime): starting rollback: 
```bash
# rollback command
redwoodctl deploy set-image inference/model-runner model-runner:v2.13 --cluster prod-usw2 --namespace inference
```

elaine (eng-runtime): rolling restart triggered, canarying to 3 pods first. Monitoring logs.

eng-runtime-bot: Canaries: 0/3 segfaults on new pods (v2.13) observed in first 5m window. Old pods still crashing.

marta (ops-sre): node pressure dropping as new pods schedule on other nodes. Evictions slowed. Nice.

sam (support): support escalations paused; we see successful requests beginning to flow through the canary pods. Two customers report reduced errors.

ryan (oncall): still seeing some 5xx from edge gateway; possible leftover connections to crashed pods. I'll bump gateway retry/failover window and clear upstream caches.

elaine (eng-runtime): also disabling background aggressive batching for canary pods to reduce memory footprint: setting ENV `BATCHING_ENABLED=false` on canary.

ryan (oncall): applying a temporary routing fallback to 'model-slim-1b-quant' for high-risk customers: 
```json
{ "route": "inference.generate", "fallback_model": "model-slim-1b-quant", "criteria": { "customer": ["AcmeCorp","BoltPay"] }}
```

ana (ana typo?) No, correcting: ana (support): confirmed AcmeCorp success for small batch of requests. They're seeing 200s now.

marta (ops-sre): after rollback and drains, crash loops reduced by ~92%. Memory OOM events no longer present on new pods.

eng-runtime-bot: metrics update: 5xx rate dropped to 1.3% in the last 10m, p95 latency down to 420ms.

sam (support): reopening any affected support tickets with update and mitigation note. We'll request post-mortem with timeline.

maya (product): please prepare a customer-facing summary for impacted customers. Keep it high-level and reassure about rollback and fix plan.

elaine (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: a regression in quant-kernel v3.7 that corrupts kv-cache pointers under certain sequence-length distributions, leading to double-free and then OOM. We need a reproducer and patch.

ryan (oncall): handoff plan: I'm going to stabilize the service for next 30m, then hand to @jaya (oncall) for the overnight watch. Primary tasks for next-oncall: monitor rollback shard, validate no regression in correctness, and coordinate rollback rollback if necessary.

jaya (oncall): ack. I'll take over at 10:30Z. I'll watch canary metrics and the canary -> global promotion window.

elaine (eng-runtime): creating a private repo branch with a small reproducer; will post link and stack trace to this thread in 30m.

marta (ops-sre): adding an autoscaler bump as temporary safety net: `keda` thresholds increased for memory to reduce churn while fixes land.

incident-bot: Status update posted to #status-page: "Mitigation in progress — rollback to stable image deployed, traffic partially diverted. Customers on fallback models. Monitoring." :white_check_mark:

sam (support): customer comms draft ready, will coordinate with maya for sign-off.

ryan (oncall): quick checklist for the handoff note to jaya: 
- rollback succeeded for canaries (v2.13)
- node drains completed for nodeset-3
- OOM events reduced to baseline
- fallback routes applied for top customers
- runbook 'model-crash' active, incident channel preserved

jaya (oncall): I'll take it from here. Please DM if anything spikes.

ryan (oncall): handing over. Final note before handoff: attach core dumps to the secure bucket: `s3://redwood-incident-dumps/5312345678/` and restrict access.

elaine (eng-runtime): uploaded one core and a short stacktrace to the bucket and linked to the reproducer branch.

marta (ops-sre): follow-up ops item: schedule a maintenance window to revert quant-kernel v3.7 across other regions after QA.

jaya (oncall): acknowledged, picking up monitoring. Leaving channel open for postmortem details.

sam (support): closing the high-priority customer escalation, will reopen if they see new issues.

incident-bot: INCIDENT state -> mitigated (partial). Assigned owners: eng-runtime (elaine) for patch, ops-sre (marta) for capacity plan, support (sam) for customer comms. Next update in 2 hours or on status change. :eyes:
